item.title: How light is a 'lightweight' e-bike really? Why are electric bikes so heavy?
item.description: E-bikes are, for the most part, honestly pretty sizeable. E-cargo bikes and mid-motor step-throughs are especially heavy, but even e-bikes billed as ‘lightweight’ can be surprisingly substantial. The average e-bike is over 20kg and many weigh a fair bit more than that. That's a lot of bike to lug about - especially if you live up a few flights of stairs or you have to lift your bike onto a rack, or into your car, or onto a train. So why are they so heavy?
